component-o.description-s: microSD card socket, push-push, top board mount, right angle, 8 contacts plus card-detect switch (closed with a card), 1.68 mm high (Hirose DM3 series, HRS 609-0031-0)

connector-o.fields_source_s: DM3 catalog p2: current rating 0.5 A, voltage rating 125 V AC, -25 to +85 C, contact resistance change 40 mOhm max; p3: 13.85 x 15.95 mm body, 1.68 mm high, card lock 17.55 mm / eject 21.55 mm from the rear; the card inserts parallel to the board

component-o.replaces_s: TF PUSH (SHOU HAN, LCSC only): same microSD contact assignment, push-push; different footprint
component-o.notes-s: Contacts #1-#8 as named on the DM3AT drawing (p3). The card detection switch (A)-(B) is open without a card and closed with one inserted (Note 2, p3); the LCSC C114218 symbol numbers DET_B 9 and DET_A 10, so (B) pin 9 goes to GND and (A) pin 10 to the card-detect input with a pull-up, reading low when a card is in. SH: the four shell tabs, ground.

source-o.source-note-s: Mouser API read through the pcbparts lookup (procurement Mouser key invalid). DigiKey stocks 77187 but its lookup shows only the 1500-piece reel HR1964TR-ND
